UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
I) IMPORTANT DATES:
I Submission of Online Forms/ Hard Copy from 10-08-2026
II Last date for Submission of Online Forms 09-09-2026 (upto 4.00 p.m.)
III Last date for submission of Hard copy 14-09-2026*
*- Candidature of candidates who fail to submit the Hard Copy of the Application Form within
the stipulated time shall be rejected without any notice.
II) QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:
i)
For the Posts of Assistant Professor unless mention elsewhere in this Advertisement:
A Master„s degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is
followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from
an accredited foreign university.
For the Post/s of Assistant Professor, Bio-Informatics:
Good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) at the PG level in Bioinformatics/ Biochemistry/ Biotechnology/ Clinical Biochemistry
from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
For the posts of Assistant Professor available in Centre of Central Asian Studies (Archaeology):
A Master‟s degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is
followed) in Culture & Archaeology/ Archaeology or History with PG Diploma in Archaeology.
For the post/s of Assistant Professor available in the Centre for Distance & Online Education (Home
Science):
Good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) at the PG level in Home Science with specialization in Human Development from an
Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
For the Post/s of Assistant Professor, Lifelong Learning:
Good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) at the PG level in Lifelong Learning/ Social Work/ Sociology/Home Science
(Extension & Communication)/ Rural Development from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree
from an accredited foreign University.
For the post/s of Assistant Professor available in the Department of Geo-Informatics:
Good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) at the PG level in Geoinformatics/ GIS/Remote Sensing or Applied Geology with PG
Diploma in Remote Sensing from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign
University.
For the post/s of Assistant Professor available in the Home Science:
Good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) at the PG level in Home Science with specialization in Dietetics & Clinical Nutrition
from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
For the post of Assistant Professor available in the Iqbal Institute of Culture & Philosoply:
Good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) at the PG level in Urdu/ Philosophy from an Indian University, or an equivalent
degree from an accredited foreign University. Further, the candidates must possess substantiated research
in Iqbal Studies. Candidates with Ph.D in Iqbal Studies will be given preference.
ii) NET shall be the compulsory requirement for those with Post-Graduate Degrees only. But, in respect of
candidates who belong to UT of J&K and are not NET qualified, SET shall be the compulsory requirement.
iii) The candidates without NET or SET having Ph.D Degree in the concerned subject in compliance of the UGC
(Minimum Standards and Procedure for award of Ph.D Degree) Regulations, 2009, with amendments from
time to time shall be exempted from the requirement of minimum eligibility conditions of NET/SET.
Provided, the candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be
governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution
awarding the degree and appointment to Assistant Professor or equivalent position/s subject to the
fulfillment of the following conditions :-
a) The Ph.D. degree of the candidate has been awarded in a regular mode;
b) The Ph.D. thesis has been evaluated by at least two external examiners;
c) An open Ph.D. viva voce of the candidate has been conducted;
d) The Candidate has published two research papers from his/her Ph.D. work, out of which at least one is in
a refereed journal;
e) The candidate has presented at least two papers based on his/her Ph.D work in conferences/seminars
sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC / ICSSR/ CSIR or any similar agency.
The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) or
Dean Research of the University concerned.
Note: A candidate with Ph.D degree obtained from a foreign university/ institution with a ranking among top 500 in
the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii)
the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai) shall also be eligible.
III) PERCENTAGE EQUIVALENCE OF GRADE POINTS FOR A SEVEN POINTS SCALE:
In the Seven Point Scale with letter grades O,A,B,C,D,E & F, “B” shall be regarded as equivalent of 55%,
wherever the grading system is followed:
Grade Grade Point %age Equivalent
O=Outstanding 5.50-6.00 75-100
A=Very Good 4.50-5.49 65-74
B=Good 3.50-4.49 55-64
C=Average 2.50-3.49 45-54
D=Below Average 1.50-2.49 35-44
E=Poor 0.50-1.49 25-34
F=Fail 0.00-0.49 00-24
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
IV) SUBMISSION OF ON-LINE APPLICATION FORMS:
Step 1: Visit http://www.kashmiruniversity.net and Click on Jobs/Recruitment link. Read detailed
Important Instructions and preview of whole process for Registration and submission of
Application Form before proceeding ahead.
Step 2: Candidate needs to register himself/herself before submitting the Online Application. For
Registration, Click on the Register as an Applicant link. Remember the Username and Password
for future reference. Use a valid Email ID and Mobile Number during registration process.
Step 3: After successful Registration, Login into the system by using your Username and Password.
Step 4: Key in the personal details, educational qualifications, experience etc then Preview the Form, if
details are correct, Click on Submit. If there is variation or you want to update, Click on Preview
button, make corrections/ updations and then Submit. Remember, no editing or updating is
allowed after the Form is submitted. Get a print out of the application form and note the Form No.
for future reference.
Step 5: Select payment for depositing Application Fee. Deposit the Application Fee of Rs. 1200/-, through
Online mode only.
However, persons with benchmark disabilities (PwD) are exempted from payment of application fee.
V) SUBMISSION OF DOWNLOADED APPLICATION FORM (HARD COPY):
Submit a Print-out of the Application Form submitted online along with the enclosures, duly numbered at
right hand top margin, as per the auto-generated serial numbers against each entry, online payment
acknowledgement, properly bound, either personally or through Speed Post/Registered Post to the Room
No.106, New Administrative Block, Main Campus, University of Kashmir, Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006,
UT of J&K.
Candidates sending print-out of their Application Forms by post should ensure that the envelope
containing Application Form is super-scribed as “Application for the post of ………………………, Post ID
………… Advertisement notice No. ………. Dated ………….” and reaches by or before the last date.
Application Form received by post after the last date shall be liable to be rejected.
VI) SHORTLISTING OF CANDIDATES:
In case large numbers of applications are received against any of the posts, the short listing of the
candidates for interview shall be made as per the criteria/parameters mentioned below, and the selections
shall be based only on the performance in the interview.
Short-listing will be carried out only in case the number of posts exceeds 20 against 01 advertised post as
per criteria above. 20 candidates will be shortlisted against 01 post and in case the number of posts exceeds
01, then 05 more applicants shall be shortlisted in order of merit for every additional post:
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net

VII) OTHER CONDITIONS:-
i) Reservation to above posts is as per the provision of S.O 305 dated 21.05.2024, issued by the UT Government,
Jammu & Kashmir.
ii) Candidate seeking exemption from NET/SLET/SET are required to produce a bona-fide certificate from the
concerned University to the effect that the said candidate has been awarded Ph.D. degree in conformity with
the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for award of Ph.D Degree) Regulations, 2009/ 2016 (whichever
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
is applicable), with amendments issued from time to time and attach a Minimum Standards Certificate (MSP)
from the concerned University.
iii) A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the Bachelor‟s as well as at the Master„s level for the candidates
belonging to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Other Backward Classes (OBC) (Non-creamy Layer)/
Differently abled ((a) Blindness and low vision; (b) Deaf and Hard of Hearing; (c) Locomotor disability
including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy; (d) Autism,
intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (e) Multiple disabilities from amongst
persons under (a) to (d) including deaf-blindness) for the purpose of eligibility and assessing good academic
record for direct recruitment. The eligibility marks of 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale
wherever the grading system is followed) and the relaxation of 5% to the categories mentioned above are
permissible, based only on the qualifying marks without including any grace mark procedure.
iv) Candidates with Ph.D degree having passed their Master‟s Degree prior to 19th September, 1991 having secured
50% or more marks in the Master‟s Degree Examination shall also be eligible to apply for the post of Assistant
Professor.
v) NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Degree Programmes in disciplines for which
NET/SLET/SET accredited test is not conducted.
vi) Candidates must provide details with regard to the date of registration/date of joining, date of submission and
date of award of degree for both M.Phil and Ph.D degrees, as the case may be, in the Application Form.
vii) Candidates who are with M.Phil/Ph.D should mention against the column „Academic Record‟ the name of the
University/Institution and Guide/Co-Guide where and under whom they are pursuing/or have completed the
M.Phil/Ph.D Degree.
viii) Relevant grade which is regarded as equivalent of 55% wherever the grading system is followed by recognized
university shall also be considered eligible.
ix) Candidates who have been awarded post graduate/Ph.D degree from Foreign University should enclose
“Equivalence Certificate” issued by Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi, without which their
candidature will not be considered and Application Form will be rejected.
x) Any publications in predatory/dubious journals or presentations in predatory/dubious conferences shall not
be considered for academic credit for selection and confirmation. With effect from 14.6.2019, research
publications from journals indexed in UGC-CARE Listed Journals/ Scopus/ Web of Science listed Journals
only would be considered for all academic purposes.
xi) Terms and conditions of appointment of the candidates shall be governed by the provisions of the Kashmir &
Jammu Universities Act, 1969, and Statutes & Regulations made there under from time to time, University
Grants Commission and the Union Ministry of Education, whichever applicable.
xii) Where the University does not have its own service rules, those prescribed by the Government of the UT for its
employees are, mutatis mutandis, applicable to the University employees also.
xiii) Services of the appointees shall be transferable between different Satellite Campuses of the University of
Kashmir.
xiv) Candidates shall be asked to produce the original documents relating to their age, qualifications, experience,
fitness and other claims whatsoever at any time during the selection process.
xv) Candidates invited for interview shall not be paid any T.A and D.A.
xvi) The Application fee once paid will not be refunded or re-adjusted under any circumstances.
xvii) During the period of probation, the candidate shall be required to make consistent efforts for bringing out the
quality publications in UGC-CARE Journals with ISSN Number etc. Besides pursuing research work of tangible
standards and will be required to take one Research Project in the area of their specialization.
xviii) The University reserves the right not to fill any of the vacancies advertised, if circumstance so warrant, without
assigning any reason thereof.
xix) The number of vacancies indicated in Advertisement Notice is tentative. The University reserves the right to
increase/decrease the number of posts at the time of selection.
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
xx) Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) certificate submitted in support of the claim of reservation under this
category must be valid at least till 31st December, 2026. Only those candidates shall be considered for
reservation under EWS category, if gross family annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh (Rupees eight lakh only)
for the financial year prior to the year of application. The term “Family” for this purpose will include the
person who seeks benefit of reservation, his/her parents and siblings below the age of 18 years, his/her spouse
and children below the age of 18 years. Also, persons whose family owns or possesses any of the assets as
mentioned in GoI, No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31st January, 2019 shall also be excluded from being
identified as EWS, irrespective of the family income. The Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) certificates in
the proforma prescribed and issued by any of the authorities stated in the OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt. (Res)
dated 31.01.2019 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidate‟s claim for belonging to
EWSs. EWSs certificates are required to be submitted with duly completed application form. No other
certificate will be accepted as a sufficient proof.
xxi) EWS indicates that the position is for EWS category only. However, since EWS vacancies are not to be
carried forward to the next recruitment year as backlog, as such, in case EWS candidate/s are not available/
found suitable, the said position/s shall be filled by the University under UR category. As such, UR
candidates can also apply on their own risk and responsibility against the EWS category and their
candidature shall be considered only in case of non-availability/ non-suitability of EWS candidates.
xxii) The Candidates applying under various categories shall be required to produce the valid relevant category
certificate/s duly issued by the Competent Authority failing which their candidature shall not be entertained;
xxiii) The candidates are advised to carefully choose/ apply against the relevant category applicable to him/ her. No
updation for change of Category/ Post Code or any field shall be considered after the submission of the online
application form.
xxiv) 4% horizontal reservation shall be provided to Physically Handicapped Category candidates in accordance
with the applicable University rules. Further, Ex-Servicemen shall be entitled to such benefits as admissible
under the rules/orders issued by the Government of Jammu & Kashmir/UT Administration from time to time.
xxv) The appointment under SC/ST-1/ST-2/BA/OBC/EWS/LAC/IB quota is provisional and is subject to the
community certificate being verified through the proper channels. If the verification reveals that the claim of
the candidate to belong to SC/ST-1/ST-2/BA/OBC/EWS/LAC/IB or "not belonging to creamy layer" is false,
his/her services will be terminated forthwith without assigning any further reasons and without prejudice to
such further action as may be deemed appropriate for production of false certificate.
VIII) GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
i) Applications by Government servants should be sent through the Administrative Authority concerned. In the
case of the University Teachers/Employees, through the Registrar of their respective University and in the case
of persons employed in the Affiliated Institutions through the Competent authority of the concerned Affiliating
Institution. APPLICATIONS NOT ROUTED THROUGH THE RESPECTIVE CHANNELS ARE LIABLE TO BE
REJECTED. However such candidates are advised not to wait for the last date and an advance copy may be
sent at the earliest followed by application through proper channel.
ii) Applications received late or on plain paper or incomplete in any respect shall not be entertained.
iii) Only those candidates should apply for the post/s, who fulfil all the eligibility criteria by the last date laid
down in the advertisement notice by the University.
iv) Candidates are advised to regularly check University Website/ login to his/her profile using username and
password for latest updates/important instructions/ API Score, released by the University from time to time.
v) The interview call letters shall be sent through E-mail/SMS as mentioned at the time of Registration. However, the
University shall not be responsible for non-delivery of E-mail/SMS due to technical or any other issues. As such,
Candidates are advised to regularly check University website for latest updates.
vi) All enclosures attached with the Application Form should be self attested and attached in the same order as of
the Serial Number generated against each entry. Incomplete Application Forms and without enclosures shall be
rejected.
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
vii) The Experience Certificates, if any, should be issued/ duly authenticated by the Competent Authority failing
which, the same shall not be entertained.
viii) Impersonation or submission of false/fabricated/tampered documents or making incorrect/false statements by
a candidate, will, in addition to debarring him/her permanently or for a specific period from any employment
in the University, also render him/her liable for criminal prosecution.
ix) Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of the candidate will lead to disqualification.
x) The University shall verify the character and antecedents of all the candidates and documents submitted by
them at any time of appointment or during the tenure of service. In case, it is detected that the documents
submitted are fake or the candidate has a clandestine antecedents/background and has suppressed the said
information, his/her services shall be terminated forthwith and the action shall be taken as warranted under
rules.
xi) Addendum/ Corrigendum/ Notice to this advertisement shall be uploaded on the university website only.
As such, Candidates are advised to regularly check University website for latest updates/important
instructions, released by the University from time to time. No separate/ individual intimation in this regard
shall be given.
xii) There should be a minimum three eligible applicants in order to conduct the interview, and in case of less
number of eligible applicants, the post shall be put to re-advertisement.
xiii) Candidate/s desirous to submit application form in more than one Category/ Campus shall have to apply
separately for each Category/ Campus, subject to fulfilment of eligibility conditions.
xiv) This is subject to the outcome of writ petition(s) if any, pending before any competent court of law.
Sd/-
